Test coverage report built with pdoc

vibefpmgui.build_monitor

Live table of the files fpm is compiling, fed from fpm's console output.

When its output is not a terminal, fpm prints one line when it starts a target and another when it finishes, e.g.::

[ 11%]            json_parameters.F90
[ 22%]            json_parameters.F90  done.

With an OpenMP-enabled fpm several files compile at once, so start and finish lines interleave. fpm prints "done." even for a file that failed to compile, so failures and warnings come from the compiler diagnostics instead (path:line:col: followed by Error:/Warning:) and from fpm's <ERROR> Compilation failed for object " app_main.f90.o " line.

fpm only echoes compiler output when a compile fails; otherwise it is kept in build/<compiler>_<hash>/<package>/<object>.o.log, so that log is read when a file finishes to pick up its warnings.

The table is drawn by RowDelegate: status badges (with a spinner while compiling), package tags, and per-file timing bars scaled to the slowest file. The summary chips above it filter the table by status.

   1"""Live table of the files fpm is compiling, fed from fpm's console output.
   2
   3When its output is not a terminal, fpm prints one line when it starts a
   4target and another when it finishes, e.g.::
   5
   6    [ 11%]            json_parameters.F90
   7    [ 22%]            json_parameters.F90  done.
   8
   9With an OpenMP-enabled fpm several files compile at once, so start and finish
  10lines interleave.  fpm prints "done." even for a file that failed to compile,
  11so failures and warnings come from the compiler diagnostics instead
  12(``path:line:col:`` followed by ``Error:``/``Warning:``) and from fpm's
  13``<ERROR> Compilation failed for object " app_main.f90.o "`` line.
  14
  15fpm only echoes compiler output when a compile fails; otherwise it is kept in
  16``build/<compiler>_<hash>/<package>/<object>.o.log``, so that log is read when
  17a file finishes to pick up its warnings.
  18
  19The table is drawn by `RowDelegate`: status badges (with a spinner
  20while compiling), package tags, and per-file timing bars scaled to the slowest
  21file.  The summary chips above it filter the table by status.
  22"""

  64PROGRESS_RE = re.compile(r"^\[\s*(\d+)%\]\s+(\S+)(?:\s+(done|failed)\.)?\s*$")
  65# gfortran/gcc: "src/a.f90:3:15:" (message on later lines) or "a.c:3:5: error: ..."
  66# (An optional "C:" drive prefix, so Windows paths aren't cut at the drive colon.)
  67GNU_LOC_RE = re.compile(r"^((?:[A-Za-z]:)?[^:\s]+?):(\d+):(?:(\d+):)?\s*"
  68                        r"(?:(fatal error|error|warning)\b:?\s*(.*))?$", re.IGNORECASE)
  69# Intel: "src/a.f90(3): error #5082: ..."
  70INTEL_LOC_RE = re.compile(r"^((?:[A-Za-z]:)?[^:\s(]+?)\((\d+)\):\s*(error|warning|remark)\b[^:]*:\s*(.*)$",
  71                          re.IGNORECASE)
  72GNU_SEVERITY_RE = re.compile(r"^(Fatal Error|Error|Warning):\s*(.*)$")
  73# lfortran: "semantic error: ..." / "warning: ..." / "style suggestion: ...",
  74# then " --> src/a.f90:3:15" on the next line.
  75LFORTRAN_SEVERITY_RE = re.compile(r"^(?:[a-z]+ )?(error|warning|style suggestion):\s*(.*)$")
  76LFORTRAN_LOC_RE = re.compile(r"^\s*-->\s*((?:[A-Za-z]:)?.+?):(\d+)(?::\d+)?\s*$")
  77FAILED_OBJECT_RE = re.compile(r'Compilation failed for object\s+"\s*(.+?)\s*"')
  78UP_TO_DATE_RE = re.compile(r"Project is up to date")
  79

 121class Diagnostic(NamedTuple):
 122    file: str      # as the compiler printed it
 123    line: int
 124    severity: str  # "error", "fatal error", "warning" or "remark"
 125    message: str   # one-line summary including the location
 126
 127
 128class DiagnosticParser:
 129    """Turns compiler output, one line at a time, into `Diagnostic`."""
 130
 131    def __init__(self):
 132        self._location: tuple[str, int] | None = None  # gfortran prints the severity later
 133        self._pending: tuple[str, str] | None = None  # lfortran prints the location later
 134
 135    def feed(self, line: str) -> Diagnostic | None:
 136        match = LFORTRAN_SEVERITY_RE.match(line)
 137        if match:
 138            severity = "remark" if match.group(1) == "style suggestion" else match.group(1)
 139            self._pending = (severity, line)
 140            return None
 141        if self._pending:
 142            match = LFORTRAN_LOC_RE.match(line)
 143            if match:
 144                (severity, text), self._pending = self._pending, None
 145                return Diagnostic(match.group(1), int(match.group(2)), severity,
 146                                  f"{match.group(1)}:{match.group(2)}: {text}")
 147        match = INTEL_LOC_RE.match(line)
 148        if match:
 149            return Diagnostic(match.group(1), int(match.group(2)), match.group(3).lower(), line)
 150        match = GNU_LOC_RE.match(line)
 151        if match and Path(match.group(1)).suffix.lower() in SOURCE_EXTS:
 152            if match.group(4):  # severity on the same line (gcc/clang style)
 153                return Diagnostic(match.group(1), int(match.group(2)), match.group(4).lower(), line)
 154            self._location = (match.group(1), int(match.group(2)))
 155            return None
 156        match = GNU_SEVERITY_RE.match(line)
 157        if match and self._location:
 158            (file, number), self._location = self._location, None
 159            return Diagnostic(file, number, match.group(1).lower(), f"{file}:{number}: {line}")
 160        return None
 161
 162
 163LOG_READ_LIMIT = 1_000_000  # bytes of a compiler log read (half from each end)
 164
 165
 166def read_log_text(log: Path) -> str:
 167    """A compiler log's text. A huge one (an lfortran crash writes the whole
 168    compiled program, 100+ MB) is read as its start and end only, which is
 169    where the messages are; reading and showing all of it would freeze the app."""
 170    size = log.stat().st_size
 171    if size <= LOG_READ_LIMIT:
 172        return log.read_text(errors="replace")
 173    half = LOG_READ_LIMIT // 2
 174    with open(log, "rb") as f:
 175        head = f.read(half)
 176        f.seek(size - half)
 177        tail = f.read()
 178    head = head[:head.rfind(b"\n") + 1] or head  # whole lines only
 179    tail = tail[tail.find(b"\n") + 1:] or tail
 180    skipped = size - len(head) - len(tail)
 181    return (head.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
 182            + f"\n[… {skipped / 1e6:.1f} MB of compiler output not shown — full log: {log} …]\n\n"
 183            + tail.decode("utf-8", errors="replace"))
 184
 185
 186def target_kind(name: str) -> str:
 187    suffix = Path(name).suffix.lower()
 188    if suffix in SOURCE_EXTS:
 189        return "Source"
 190    if suffix in (".a", ".so", ".dylib", ".lib", ".dll"):
 191        return "Library"
 192    return "Executable"

 195@dataclass
 196class Target:
 197    name: str
 198    row: int
 199    seq: int = 0  # original (start) order, for "unsorted"
 200    status: str = COMPILING
 201    started: float = field(default_factory=time.monotonic)
 202    finished: float | None = None
 203    messages: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
 204    warnings: int = 0
 205    errors: int = 0
 206    candidates: list[tuple[str, Path]] = field(default_factory=list)  # (package, source)
 207    path: Path | None = None  # resolved source file
 208    log_text: str = ""  # the compiler's full output (fpm's .o.log)
 209    diagnostics: list[Diagnostic] = field(default_factory=list)
 210    package: str = ""
 211    package_kind: str = LIBRARY
 212
 213    def elapsed(self) -> float:
 214        return (self.finished or time.monotonic()) - self.started

 217def index_sources(graph: m.DependencyGraph | None) -> dict[str, list[tuple[str, Path]]]:
 218    """Map source file basename -> [(package, full path)] for every package
 219    on disk, so table rows can say which package a file belongs to."""
 220    index: dict[str, list[tuple[str, Path]]] = {}
 221    if graph is None:
 222        return index
 223    packages = [p for p in graph.packages.values()
 224                if p.directory and p.directory.is_dir() and p.kind != m.MISSING]
 225    package_dirs = {p.directory.resolve() for p in packages}
 226    for pkg in packages:
 227        own = pkg.directory.resolve()
 228        for dirpath, dirnames, filenames in os.walk(own):
 229            # Skip build trees (they hold other packages' sources), VCS dirs,
 230            # and nested packages (e.g. a path dependency inside the project),
 231            # which are indexed under their own name.
 232            dirnames[:] = [d for d in dirnames if d != "build" and not d.startswith(".")
 233                           and (Path(dirpath) / d).resolve() not in package_dirs]
 234            for f in filenames:
 235                if Path(f).suffix.lower() in SOURCE_EXTS:
 236                    index.setdefault(f, []).append((pkg.name, Path(dirpath) / f))
 237    return index

 247def panel_stylesheet(object_name: str, pal: dict) -> str:
 248    """Flat table/header/scrollbar styling shared by the build and test panels."""

 250    return f"""
 251        {n} {{ background: {pal['bg']}; }}
 252        {n} QLabel {{ color: {pal['text']}; background: transparent; }}
 253        {n} QTableView {{ background: {pal['bg']}; border: none; }}
 254        {n} QHeaderView {{ background: {pal['bg']}; }}
 255        {n} QAbstractScrollArea::corner {{ background: transparent; border: none; }}
 256        {n} QScrollBar:vertical {{ background: transparent; width: 8px; margin: 2px; }}
 257        {n} QScrollBar::handle:vertical {{ background: {pal['track']}; border-radius: 3px;
 258            min-height: 24px; }}
 259        {n} QScrollBar::handle:vertical:hover {{ background: {pal['muted']}; }}
 260        {n} QScrollBar:horizontal {{ background: transparent; height: 8px; margin: 2px; }}
 261        {n} QScrollBar::handle:horizontal {{ background: {pal['track']}; border-radius: 3px;
 262            min-width: 24px; }}
 263        {n} QScrollBar::handle:horizontal:hover {{ background: {pal['muted']}; }}
 264        {n} QScrollBar::add-line, {n} QScrollBar::sub-line,
 265        {n} QScrollBar::add-page, {n} QScrollBar::sub-page {{ background: none; height: 0; }}
 266        {n} QScrollBar::add-line:horizontal, {n} QScrollBar::sub-line:horizontal,
 267        {n} QScrollBar::add-page:horizontal, {n} QScrollBar::sub-page:horizontal {{ width: 0; }}
 268        {n} QHeaderView::section {{
 269            background: {pal['bg']}; color: {pal['muted']}; border: none;
 270            border-bottom: 1px solid {pal['line']}; padding: 6px 12px;
 271            font-size: {scaled(10)}px; font-weight: 600; }}
 272    """

 275def chip_stylesheet(pal: dict, color: str) -> str:
 276    """A rounded, tinted, checkable summary chip."""
 277    c = QColor(color)
 278    rgb = f"{c.red()},{c.green()},{c.blue()}"
 279    return f"""
 280        QPushButton {{ background: rgba({rgb},40); color: {pal['text']}; border: 1px solid transparent;
 281            border-radius: 10px; padding: 2px 10px; font-weight: 600; }}
 282        QPushButton:hover {{ background: rgba({rgb},70); }}
 283        QPushButton:checked {{ background: rgba({rgb},90); border: 1px solid rgb({rgb}); }}
 284    """

 291def paint_name_and_detail(p: QPainter, r: QRectF, name: str, detail: str, bold: QFont, small: QFont,
 292                          color: QColor, muted: QColor, detail_elide=Qt.ElideRight):
 293    """A row's name (bold) and, on the same line after it, its detail in
 294    small grey text (a file's folder, a test's exit code), each shortened
 295    to fit: the name keeps at least 60% of the room when both don't fit."""
 296    gap = 8
 297    name_metrics = QFontMetricsF(bold)
 298    name_width = name_metrics.horizontalAdvance(name)
 299    if detail:
 300        detail_width = QFontMetricsF(small).horizontalAdvance(detail)
 301        if name_width + gap + detail_width > r.width():
 302            name_width = min(name_width, max(r.width() * 0.6, r.width() - gap - detail_width))
 303    shown = name_metrics.elidedText(name, Qt.ElideMiddle, min(name_width, r.width()) + 1)
 304    p.setFont(bold)
 305    p.setPen(color)
 306    p.drawText(r, Qt.AlignLeft | Qt.AlignVCenter, shown)
 307    if not detail:
 308        return
 309    left = r.left() + name_metrics.horizontalAdvance(shown) + gap
 310    room = r.right() - left
 311    if room < 20:
 312        return
 313    p.setFont(small)
 314    p.setPen(muted)
 315    p.drawText(QRectF(left, r.top(), room, r.height()), Qt.AlignLeft | Qt.AlignVCenter,
 316               QFontMetricsF(small).elidedText(detail, detail_elide, room))

 319class RowDelegate(QStyledItemDelegate):
 320    """Paints every cell of the build table from its `Target`."""
 321
 322    def __init__(self, monitor: BuildMonitor):
 323        super().__init__(monitor.table)
 324        self.monitor = monitor
 325
 326    def sizeHint(self, option, index):
 327        return QSize(100, scaled(COMPACT_ROW_HEIGHT))
 328
 329    def paint(self, p: QPainter, option, index):
 330        mon = self.monitor
 331        if index.row() >= len(mon.targets):
 332            return
 333        target = mon.targets[index.row()]
 334        pal = mon.palette_colors
 335        r = QRectF(option.rect)
 336        p.save()
 337        p.setRenderHint(QPainter.Antialiasing)
 338        status_color = QColor(pal["status"][target.status])
 339
 340        if index.row() == mon.selected_row:
 341            p.fillRect(r, _tint(QColor(pal["accent1"]), 28))
 342            if index.column() == 0:
 343                p.fillRect(QRectF(r.left(), r.top() + 6, 3, r.height() - 12), QColor(pal["accent1"]))
 344        elif index.row() == mon.hover_row:
 345            p.fillRect(r, QColor(pal["hover"]))
 346        if target.finished is not None:  # fade-out flash when a file finishes
 347            age = time.monotonic() - target.finished
 348            if age < FLASH_SECONDS:
 349                p.fillRect(r, _tint(status_color, int(35 * (1 - age / FLASH_SECONDS))))
 350        p.setPen(QPen(QColor(pal["line"]), 1))
 351        p.drawLine(r.bottomLeft(), r.bottomRight())
 352
 353        small = QFont(option.font)
 354        small.setPointSizeF(max(option.font.pointSizeF() - 2, 7))
 355        column = index.column()
 356        if column == 0:
 357            self._paint_file(p, r, target, option.font, small, pal)
 358        elif column == 1:
 359            self._paint_package(p, r, target, small, pal)
 360        elif column == 2:
 361            self._paint_status(p, r, target, small, pal, status_color)
 362        else:
 363            self._paint_time(p, r, target, small, pal, status_color)
 364        p.restore()
 365
 366    def _paint_file(self, p, r, target, font, small, pal):
 367        bold = QFont(font)
 368        bold.setWeight(QFont.DemiBold)
 369        paint_name_and_detail(p, r.adjusted(14, 0, -6, 0), target.name, self.monitor.display_folder(target),
 370                              bold, small, QColor(pal["text"]), QColor(pal["muted"]), Qt.ElideLeft)
 371
 372    def _paint_package(self, p, r, target, small, pal):
 373        if not target.package:
 374            return
 375        color = QColor(self.monitor.package_colors.get(target.package_kind, pal["muted"]))
 376        fm = QFontMetricsF(small)
 377        text = fm.elidedText(target.package, Qt.ElideRight, r.width() - 46)
 378        pill = QRectF(r.left() + 8, r.center().y() - 9, fm.horizontalAdvance(text) + 28, 18)
 379        p.setPen(Qt.NoPen)
 380        p.setBrush(_tint(color, 50))
 381        p.drawRoundedRect(pill, 9, 9)
 382        p.setBrush(color)
 383        p.drawEllipse(QRectF(pill.left() + 7, pill.center().y() - 3, 6, 6))
 384        p.setFont(small)
 385        p.setPen(QColor(pal["text"]))
 386        p.drawText(pill.adjusted(17, 0, 0, 0), Qt.AlignVCenter | Qt.AlignLeft, text)
 387
 388    def _paint_status(self, p, r, target, small, pal, color):
 389        text = f"{target.warnings} warning{'s' * (target.warnings != 1)}" \
 390            if target.status == WARNING else target.status
 391        font = QFont(small)
 392        font.setWeight(QFont.DemiBold)
 393        pill = QRectF(r.left() + 8, r.center().y() - 10,
 394                      QFontMetricsF(font).horizontalAdvance(text) + 36, 20)
 395        p.setPen(Qt.NoPen)
 396        p.setBrush(_tint(color, 40))
 397        p.drawRoundedRect(pill, 10, 10)
 398        icon = QRectF(pill.left() + 8, pill.center().y() - 6, 12, 12)
 399        if target.status == COMPILING:  # spinning arc
 400            p.setPen(QPen(_tint(color, 70), 2))
 401            p.drawEllipse(icon)
 402            p.setPen(QPen(color, 2, Qt.SolidLine, Qt.RoundCap))
 403            p.drawArc(icon, int(-self.monitor.spinner_angle * 16), -110 * 16)
 404        else:
 405            p.setFont(font)
 406            p.setPen(color)
 407            p.drawText(icon.adjusted(-3, -3, 3, 3), Qt.AlignCenter, STATUS_ICONS[target.status])
 408        p.setFont(font)
 409        p.setPen(color.darker(115) if self.monitor.is_light else color)
 410        p.drawText(pill.adjusted(27, 0, -6, 0), Qt.AlignVCenter | Qt.AlignLeft, text)
 411
 412    def _paint_time(self, p, r, target, small, pal, color):
 413        elapsed = target.elapsed()
 414        slowest = self.monitor.slowest()
 415        track = QRectF(r.left() + 10, r.center().y() - 3, max(r.width() - 74, 10), 6)
 416        p.setPen(Qt.NoPen)
 417        p.setBrush(QColor(pal["track"]))
 418        p.drawRoundedRect(track, 3, 3)
 419        # Live bars use the status color; finished ones are grey.
 420        bar_color = color if target.status == COMPILING else QColor(pal["muted"])
 421        fraction = elapsed / slowest if slowest > 0 else 0
 422        p.setBrush(bar_color)
 423        p.drawRoundedRect(QRectF(track.left(), track.top(), max(track.width() * fraction, 3), 6), 3, 3)
 424        mono = QFontDatabase.systemFont(QFontDatabase.FixedFont)
 425        mono.setPointSizeF(small.pointSizeF())
 426        p.setFont(mono)
 427        p.setPen(QColor(pal["text"] if target.status == COMPILING else pal["muted"]))
 428        p.drawText(r.adjusted(0, 0, -12, 0), Qt.AlignVCenter | Qt.AlignRight, f"{elapsed:.1f} s")
 429
 430
 431class SortableTable:
 432    """Click-to-sort for the custom-drawn status tables.
 433
 434    The delegates paint row *n* from ``rows()[n]``, so instead of Qt's own
 435    sorting (which would reorder the items but not our list) the list itself
 436    is sorted and every row's items are rewritten. Clicking a header cycles
 437    through: sorted, reversed, original order. The order is kept while rows
 438    are added or change (re-sorted a few times a second at most).
 439
 440    Subclasses provide ``table``, ``COLUMNS``, ``rows()``, ``_sync_row(i)``
 441    and ``_reapply_filter()``, and may override ``_selected_object`` /
 442    ``_restore_selection`` to keep the selection on the same object.
 443    """
 444
 445    def _init_sorting(self, keys: dict, descending_first: set[int] = frozenset()):
 446        self._sort_keys = keys
 447        self._sort_desc_first = set(descending_first)
 448        self.sort_column = -1
 449        self.sort_descending = False
 450        self._sort_clicks = 0
 451        header = self.table.horizontalHeader()
 452        header.setSectionsClickable(True)
 453        header.sectionClicked.connect(self._header_clicked)
 454        self._sort_timer = QTimer(self)
 455        self._sort_timer.setSingleShot(True)
 456        self._sort_timer.setInterval(150)
 457        self._sort_timer.timeout.connect(self.apply_sort)
 458        for column in keys:
 459            item = self.table.horizontalHeaderItem(column)
 460            if item is not None:
 461                item.setToolTip("Click to sort (again to reverse, a third time for the original order)")
 462
 463    def _header_clicked(self, column: int):
 464        if column not in self._sort_keys:
 465            return
 466        if column != self.sort_column:
 467            self.sort_column = column
 468            self.sort_descending = column in self._sort_desc_first
 469            self._sort_clicks = 1
 470        elif self._sort_clicks == 1:
 471            self.sort_descending = not self.sort_descending
 472            self._sort_clicks = 2
 473        else:
 474            self.sort_column = -1  # back to the original order
 475            self._sort_clicks = 0
 476        self.apply_sort()
 477
 478    def schedule_sort(self):
 479        """Call when rows were added or changed; re-sorts shortly if sorted."""
 480        if self.sort_column >= 0 and not self._sort_timer.isActive():
 481            self._sort_timer.start()
 482
 483    def apply_sort(self):
 484        rows = self.rows()
 485        selected = self._selected_object()
 486        rows.sort(key=lambda o: getattr(o, "seq", 0))  # stable base: original order
 487        if self.sort_column >= 0:
 488            rows.sort(key=self._sort_keys[self.sort_column], reverse=self.sort_descending)
 489        for index, obj in enumerate(rows):
 490            if hasattr(obj, "row"):
 491                obj.row = index
 492            self._sync_row(index)
 493        self._restore_selection(selected)
 494        self._reapply_filter()
 495        self._update_sort_header()
 496        self.table.viewport().update()
 497
 498    def _update_sort_header(self):
 499        labels = []
 500        for column, name in enumerate(self.COLUMNS):
 501            if column == self.sort_column:
 502                name += " ▼" if self.sort_descending else " ▲"
 503            labels.append(name)
 504        self.table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(labels)
 505
 506    def _selected_object(self):
 507        row = getattr(self, "selected_row", -1)
 508        rows = self.rows()
 509        return rows[row] if 0 <= row < len(rows) else None
 510
 511    def _restore_selection(self, obj):
 512        if hasattr(self, "selected_row"):
 513            self.selected_row = self.rows().index(obj) if obj is not None else -1
 514
 515
 516class ProgressLine(QWidget):
 517    """Thin rounded progress bar with a gradient fill. In "busy" mode
 518    (`set_busy`) it shows a segment sliding back and forth instead of
 519    a fill, for work whose length isn't known."""
 520
 521    SEGMENT = 0.28  # busy segment width, as a fraction of the bar
 522
 523    def __init__(self, monitor: BuildMonitor):
 524        super().__init__()
 525        self.monitor = monitor
 526        self.value = 0.0
 527        self.state = "running"  # running | ok | failed | stopped
 528        self.busy = False
 529        self._busy_started = 0.0
 530        self._busy_timer = QTimer(self)
 531        self._busy_timer.setInterval(16)
 532        self._busy_timer.timeout.connect(self.update)
 533        self.setFixedHeight(6)
 534
 535    def set(self, value: float, state: str | None = None):
 536        """Show a known fraction (0..1); ends busy mode."""
 537        self._stop_busy()
 538        self.value = max(0.0, min(1.0, value))
 539        if state:
 540            self.state = state
 541        self.update()
 542
 543    def set_busy(self, busy: bool = True):
 544        """Indeterminate mode: something is happening, amount unknown."""
 545        if busy and not self.busy:
 546            self.busy = True
 547            self.state = "running"
 548            self._busy_started = time.monotonic()
 549            self._busy_timer.start()
 550        elif not busy:
 551            self._stop_busy()
 552        self.update()
 553
 554    def _stop_busy(self):
 555        self.busy = False
 556        self._busy_timer.stop()
 557
 558    def paintEvent(self, _event):
 559        pal = self.monitor.palette_colors
 560        p = QPainter(self)
 561        p.setRenderHint(QPainter.Antialiasing)
 562        r = QRectF(self.rect())
 563        p.setPen(Qt.NoPen)
 564        p.setBrush(QColor(pal["track"]))
 565        p.drawRoundedRect(r, 3, 3)
 566        if self.busy:
 567            self._paint_busy(p, r, pal)
 568            return
 569        if self.value <= 0:
 570            return
 571        if self.state == "failed":
 572            a = b = QColor(pal["status"][FAILED])
 573        elif self.state == "stopped":
 574            a = b = QColor(pal["status"][ABORTED])
 575        elif self.state == "ok":
 576            a = b = QColor(pal["status"][DONE])
 577        else:
 578            a, b = QColor(pal["accent1"]), QColor(pal["accent2"])
 579        gradient = QLinearGradient(r.topLeft(), r.topRight())
 580        gradient.setColorAt(0, a)
 581        gradient.setColorAt(1, b)
 582        p.setBrush(gradient)
 583        p.drawRoundedRect(QRectF(r.left(), r.top(), max(r.width() * self.value, 6), r.height()), 3, 3)
 584
 585    def _paint_busy(self, p: QPainter, r: QRectF, pal: dict):
 586        # Ease back and forth across the track, ~1.6 s per sweep.
 587        t = ((time.monotonic() - self._busy_started) / 1.6) % 2.0
 588        t = t if t <= 1 else 2 - t
 589        t = t * t * (3 - 2 * t)  # smoothstep
 590        seg = r.width() * self.SEGMENT
 591        x = r.left() + (r.width() - seg) * t
 592        gradient = QLinearGradient(x, 0, x + seg, 0)
 593        a, b = QColor(pal["accent1"]), QColor(pal["accent2"])
 594        edge = QColor(a)
 595        edge.setAlpha(0)
 596        gradient.setColorAt(0, edge)
 597        gradient.setColorAt(0.3, a)
 598        gradient.setColorAt(0.7, b)
 599        end = QColor(b)
 600        end.setAlpha(0)
 601        gradient.setColorAt(1, end)
 602        p.setBrush(gradient)
 603        p.drawRoundedRect(QRectF(x, r.top(), seg, r.height()), 3, 3)
 604
 605
 606# ------------------------------------------------------------------ widget
 607STATUS_SORT = {FAILED: 0, WARNING: 1, COMPILING: 2, ABORTED: 3, DONE: 4}
 608
 609
 610class LogFinder:
 611    """Finds a source file's compile log, which fpm writes as
 612    ``build/<compiler>_<hash>/<package>/<source path>.o.log``: the path is
 613    relative to the project, with "/" as "_" (``src_utils.f90.o.log``,
 614    ``build_dependencies_fmin_src_fmin.F90.o.log``). There is a folder per
 615    compiler and flag combination, and a build may create new ones.
 616
 617    Called for each file a build finishes, so it doesn't list folders: it
 618    checks for the names the file's known paths give (one stat per folder).
 619    Only when that finds nothing (the path isn't known) does it list the
 620    folders, and each listing is kept until its folder changes."""
 621
 622    def __init__(self, project_dir: Path):
 623        self.project_dir = project_dir
 624        self._root = project_dir.resolve()
 625        self.build = project_dir / "build"
 626        self._folders: tuple[tuple, list[Path]] = ((), [])  # (what they were listed from, the folders)
 627        self._listings: dict[Path, tuple[int, dict[str, list[str]]]] = {}  # folder -> (its mtime, its logs by tail)
 628        self._resolved: dict[Path, Path] = {}  # (a source's path, resolved once)
 629        self.listed = 0  # folders listed (for the tests)
 630
 631    def folders(self) -> list[Path]:
 632        """``build/*_*/*``: listed again only when a folder is added or removed."""
 633        try:
 634            configs = sorted(e.path for e in os.scandir(self.build) if e.is_dir() and "_" in e.name)
 635            key = (self.build.stat().st_mtime_ns, *((c, os.stat(c).st_mtime_ns) for c in configs))
 636        except OSError:
 637            return []
 638        if key != self._folders[0]:
 639            folders = []
 640            for config in configs:
 641                try:
 642                    folders += [Path(e.path) for e in os.scandir(config) if e.is_dir()]
 643                except OSError:
 644                    continue
 645            self._folders = (key, folders)
 646        return self._folders[1]
 647
 648    def log_names(self, name: str, paths: list[Path]) -> list[str]:
 649        """The log names fpm would give a file with this name and these paths."""
 650        names = [f"{name}.o.log"]
 651        for path in paths:
 652            resolved = self._resolved.get(path)
 653            if resolved is None:
 654                resolved = self._resolved[path] = Path(path).resolve()
 655            try:
 656                rel = os.path.relpath(resolved, self._root)
 657            except ValueError:  # (Windows: another drive)
 658                continue
 659            names.append(rel.replace("\\", "_").replace("/", "_") + ".o.log")
 660        return names
 661
 662    def find(self, name: str, paths: list[Path], since: float) -> list[tuple[float, Path]]:
 663        """(modification time, log) of the logs for a source file written
 664        since ``since`` (the build's start)."""
 665        folders = self.folders()
 666        found = []
 667        log_names = self.log_names(name, paths)
 668        for folder in folders:
 669            for log_name in log_names:
 670                found += self._if_new(folder / log_name, since)
 671        if found:
 672            return found
 673        own = f"{name}.o.log"
 674        for folder in folders:  # (not found by its path, or that isn't known: any log of that file name)
 675            for log_name in self._listing(folder).get(_tail(own), ()):
 676                if log_name == own or log_name.endswith(f"_{own}"):
 677                    found += self._if_new(folder / log_name, since)
 678        return found
 679
 680    @staticmethod
 681    def _if_new(log: Path, since: float) -> list[tuple[float, Path]]:
 682        try:
 683            mtime = log.stat().st_mtime
 684        except OSError:
 685            return []
 686        return [(mtime, log)] if mtime >= since else []
 687
 688    def _listing(self, folder: Path) -> dict[str, list[str]]:
 689        """The folder's logs, by their names' tails (see `_tail`): a file's
 690        are under its own name's tail, so they're found without going
 691        through every log of a big build."""
 692        try:
 693            mtime = folder.stat().st_mtime_ns
 694        except OSError:
 695            return {}
 696        cached = self._listings.get(folder)
 697        if cached is None or cached[0] != mtime:
 698            self.listed += 1
 699            by_tail: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
 700            try:
 701                for entry in os.scandir(folder):
 702                    if entry.name.endswith(".o.log"):
 703                        by_tail.setdefault(_tail(entry.name), []).append(entry.name)
 704            except OSError:
 705                pass
 706            cached = self._listings[folder] = (mtime, by_tail)
 707        return cached[1]
 708
 709
 710def _tail(log_name: str) -> str:
 711    """A log's name after its last "_" (fpm's "src_sub_name.f90.o.log" →
 712    "name.f90.o.log"): "a_b.f90.o.log" and "src_a_b.f90.o.log" share theirs."""
 713    return log_name.rsplit("_", 1)[-1]
 714

 730class BuildMonitor(SortableTable, QWidget):
 731    """Per-file compile status: header with filter chips, a slim progress bar
 732    and a custom-drawn table."""
 733
 734    COLUMNS: ClassVar[list[str]] = ["FILE", "PACKAGE", "STATUS", "TIME"]
 735    # Row clicked: show that file's compiler messages (-1: show all output).
 736    details_requested = Signal(int)
 737    # Double-click: open (path, [Diagnostic]) in an editor.
 738    open_file_requested = Signal(str, list)
 739    # Right-click → Show Compile Command (source path).
 740    compile_command_requested = Signal(str)
 741
 742    def __init__(self, parent=None):
 743        super().__init__(parent)
 744        self.targets: list[Target] = []
 745        self.sources: dict[str, list[tuple[str, Path]]] = {}
 746        self.package_kinds: dict[str, str] = {}
 747        self.package_colors = dict(DEFAULT_PACKAGE_COLORS)
 748        self.diagnostics = DiagnosticParser()
 749        self.project_dir: Path | None = None
 750        self._logs: LogFinder | None = None  # (where the compile logs are: see _read_log)
 751        self.hover_row = -1
 752        self.selected_row = -1
 753        self.spinner_angle = 0.0
 754        self.peak_parallel = 0
 755        self.filter_status: str | None = None
 756        self.description = ""
 757        self._build_started = 0.0  # wall clock, to compare with log mtimes
 758        self._started = 0.0        # monotonic, for the elapsed time
 759        self._finished_at: float | None = None
 760        self._percent = 0
 761        self._result = ""          # "", "ok", "failed", "stopped", "uptodate"
 762        self._active = False
 763        self.is_light = True
 764        self.palette_colors = PALETTES["light"]
 765
 766        self.setObjectName("BuildMonitor")
 767        self.setAttribute(Qt.WA_StyledBackground, True)
 768
 769        self.title_icon = TitleIcon("build")
 770        self.title = QLabel("Build")
 771        title_font = self.title.font()
 772        title_font.setPointSizeF(title_font.pointSizeF() + 2)
 773        title_font.setWeight(QFont.Bold)
 774        self.title.setFont(title_font)
 775        self.subtitle = StatusLabel()
 776        self.chips: dict[str, QPushButton] = {}
 777        header = QHBoxLayout()
 778        header.setSpacing(6)
 779        header.addWidget(self.title_icon)
 780        header.addWidget(self.title)
 781        header.addSpacing(4)
 782        header.addWidget(self.subtitle)
 783        header.addStretch(1)
 784        for status in STATUSES:
 785            chip = QPushButton()
 786            chip.setCheckable(True)
 787            chip.setCursor(Qt.PointingHandCursor)
 788            chip.setToolTip(f"Show only “{status}” files (click again to show all)")
 789            chip.clicked.connect(lambda checked, s=status: self.set_filter(s if checked else None))
 790            chip.hide()
 791            header.addWidget(chip)
 792            self.chips[status] = chip
 793
 794        self.progress = ProgressLine(self)
 795        self.progress_label = StatusLabel()
 796        progress_row = QHBoxLayout()
 797        progress_row.setSpacing(10)
 798        progress_row.addWidget(self.progress, 1)
 799        progress_row.addWidget(self.progress_label)
 800
 801        self.table = QTableWidget(0, len(self.COLUMNS))
 802        self.table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(self.COLUMNS)
 803        self.table.setItemDelegate(RowDelegate(self))
 804        self.table.verticalHeader().setVisible(False)
 805        self.table.verticalHeader().setDefaultSectionSize(scaled(COMPACT_ROW_HEIGHT))
 806        self.table.setShowGrid(False)
 807        self.table.setFrameShape(QTableWidget.NoFrame)
 808        self.table.setEditTriggers(QAbstractItemView.NoEditTriggers)
 809        self.table.setSelectionMode(QAbstractItemView.NoSelection)
 810        self.table.setFocusPolicy(Qt.NoFocus)
 811        self.table.setMouseTracking(True)
 812        self.table.setVerticalScrollMode(QAbstractItemView.ScrollPerPixel)
 813        self.table.cellEntered.connect(self._set_hover)
 814        self.table.viewport().installEventFilter(self)
 815        self.table.cellClicked.connect(self._row_clicked)
 816        self.table.cellDoubleClicked.connect(self._open_row)
 817        self.table.setContextMenuPolicy(Qt.CustomContextMenu)
 818        self.table.customContextMenuRequested.connect(self._context_menu)
 819        hh = self.table.horizontalHeader()
 820        hh.setHighlightSections(False)
 821        hh.setDefaultAlignment(Qt.AlignLeft | Qt.AlignVCenter)
 822        hh.setSectionResizeMode(0, QHeaderView.Stretch)
 823        for column in (1, 2, 3):
 824            hh.setSectionResizeMode(column, QHeaderView.Fixed)
 825        self.table.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(Qt.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)
 826        self._fit_columns()
 827        self._init_sorting({
 828            0: lambda t: t.name.lower(),
 829            1: lambda t: (t.package.lower(), t.name.lower()),
 830            2: lambda t: (STATUS_SORT.get(t.status, 9), -t.warnings),
 831            3: lambda t: t.elapsed(),
 832        }, descending_first={3})
 833
 834        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
 835        layout.setContentsMargins(14, 10, 14, 6)
 836        layout.setSpacing(8)
 837        layout.addLayout(header)
 838        layout.addLayout(progress_row)
 839        layout.addWidget(self.table, 1)
 840        # Shown instead of the table (and its column headers) while it's empty.
 841        self.empty = QLabel()
 842        self.empty.setAlignment(Qt.AlignCenter)
 843        self.empty.setWordWrap(True)
 844        layout.addWidget(self.empty, 1)
 845
 846        self._header_pending = False  # (see _header_later)
 847        # Drives the spinner, the live times and the finish flash.
 848        self._timer = QTimer(self)
 849        self._timer.setInterval(50)
 850        self._timer.timeout.connect(self._tick)
 851
 852        self.refresh_palette()
 853        self.update_header()
 854
 855    # ------------------------------------------------------------- styling
 856    def refresh_palette(self):
 857        """Follow the application's light/dark palette."""
 858        self.is_light = app_is_light()
 859        self.palette_colors = PALETTES["light" if self.is_light else "dark"]
 860        self.setStyleSheet(panel_stylesheet(self.objectName(), self.palette_colors))
 861        self.empty.setStyleSheet(f"color: {self.palette_colors['muted']};")
 862        self.title_icon.draw(self.palette_colors["text"], self.title)
 863        self._style_chips()
 864        self.update_header()
 865        self.table.viewport().update()
 866        self.progress.update()
 867
 868    def set_package_colors(self, colors: dict[str, str]):
 869        """Use the dependency graph's colors for the package tags."""
 870        self.package_colors = {**DEFAULT_PACKAGE_COLORS, **colors}
 871        self.table.viewport().update()
 872
 873    def _style_chips(self):
 874        pal = self.palette_colors
 875        for status, chip in self.chips.items():
 876            chip.setStyleSheet(chip_stylesheet(pal, pal["status"][status]))
 877
 878    # ----------------------------------------------------------- lifecycle
 879    def start(self, graph: m.DependencyGraph | None, project_dir: Path, description: str = ""):
 880        self.targets.clear()
 881        self.selected_row = -1
 882        self.table.setRowCount(0)
 883        self.sources = index_sources(graph)
 884        self.package_kinds = {n: p.kind for n, p in graph.packages.items()} if graph else {}
 885        self.diagnostics = DiagnosticParser()
 886        self.project_dir = project_dir
 887        self._logs = LogFinder(project_dir)  # (fresh for each build: new folders)
 888        self.description = description
 889        self.peak_parallel = 0
 890        self._build_started = time.time()
 891        self._started = time.monotonic()
 892        self._finished_at = None
 893        self._percent = 0
 894        self._result = ""
 895        self._active = True
 896        self.set_filter(None)
 897        self.progress.set(0, "running")
 898        self._timer.start()
 899        self.update_header()
 900
 901    def reset(self):
 902        """Back to the empty state (e.g. when another project is opened)."""
 903        self._timer.stop()
 904        self.targets.clear()
 905        self.selected_row = -1
 906        self.table.setRowCount(0)
 907        self.project_dir = None
 908        self.description = ""
 909        self.peak_parallel = 0
 910        self._started = 0.0
 911        self._finished_at = None
 912        self._percent = 0
 913        self._result = ""
 914        self._active = False
 915        self.set_filter(None)
 916        self.progress.set(0, "running")
 917        self.update_header()
 918
 919    @property
 920    def percent(self) -> int:
 921        """How far the build is (0–100)."""
 922        return self._percent
 923
 924    def finish(self, exit_code: int, stopped: bool = False):
 925        if not self._active:
 926            return
 927        self._active = False
 928        self._finished_at = time.monotonic()
 929        for t in self.targets:
 930            if t.status == COMPILING:
 931                # A sibling's failure (or Stop) kills files still compiling.
 932                t.finished = self._finished_at
 933                self._set_status(t, ABORTED if (stopped or exit_code != 0) else DONE)
 934        if stopped:
 935            self._result = "stopped"
 936        elif exit_code != 0:
 937            self._result = "failed"
 938        elif self._result != "uptodate" or self.targets:
 939            self._result = "ok"
 940            self._percent = 100
 941        self.progress.set(self._percent / 100, {"uptodate": "ok"}.get(self._result, self._result))
 942        self.update_header()
 943        self.table.viewport().update()
 944
 945    # ------------------------------------------------------------- parsing
 946    def feed_line(self, line: str):
 947        """Process one complete line of fpm output."""
 948        if not self._active:
 949            return
 950        line = line.rstrip()
 951        if not line:
 952            return
 953
 954        match = PROGRESS_RE.match(line)
 955        if match:
 956            percent, name, end = int(match.group(1)), match.group(2).strip(), match.group(3)
 957            self._percent = max(self._percent, percent)
 958            self.progress.set(self._percent / 100)
 959            if end:
 960                target = self._find(name, running=True) or self._add(name)
 961                if target.status == COMPILING:
 962                    target.finished = time.monotonic()
 963                    self._read_log(target)
 964                    self._set_status(target, FAILED if end == "failed" or target.errors
 965                                     else WARNING if target.warnings else DONE)
 966            else:
 967                self._add(name)
 968            self._header_later()
 969            return
 970
 971        match = FAILED_OBJECT_RE.search(line)
 972        if match:
 973            target = self._find_object(match.group(1))
 974            if target:
 975                self._mark_failed(target)
 976            self._header_later()
 977            return
 978
 979        if UP_TO_DATE_RE.search(line):
 980            self._percent = 100
 981            self._result = "uptodate"
 982            self.progress.set(1.0, "ok")
 983            self.update_header()
 984            return
 985
 986        self._parse_diagnostic(line)
 987
 988    def _parse_diagnostic(self, line: str):
 989        found = self.diagnostics.feed(line)
 990        if found:
 991            target = self._find(Path(found.file).name, running=False)
 992            if target:
 993                self._record(target, found)
 994
 995    def _read_log(self, target: Target):
 996        """Pick up diagnostics for a finished source file from fpm's log."""
 997        if target_kind(target.name) != "Source":
 998            return
 999        if self.project_dir is None:
1000            return
1001        if self._logs is None or self._logs.project_dir != self.project_dir:
1002            self._logs = LogFinder(self.project_dir)
1003        logs = self._logs.find(target.name, [path for _package, path in target.candidates], self._build_started)
1004        if not logs:
1005            return
1006        log = max(logs)[1]
1007        self._resolve_owner(target, log.name)
1008        try:
1009            text = read_log_text(log)
1010        except OSError:
1011            return
1012        target.log_text = text  # shown with its colors
1013        parser = DiagnosticParser()
1014        for line in strip_ansi(text).splitlines():
1015            found = parser.feed(line.rstrip())
1016            if found:
1017                # Diagnostics in included files still belong to this target.
1018                self._record(target, found)
1019
1020    def _resolve_owner(self, target: Target, log_name: str):
1021        """Several packages may have a file of this name; fpm names the log
1022        after the source path relative to the project ("/" -> "_"), which
1023        tells them apart."""
1024        if len(target.candidates) < 2 or self.project_dir is None:
1025            return
1026        for package, path in target.candidates:
1027            try:
1028                rel = os.path.relpath(path, self.project_dir)
1029            except ValueError:
1030                continue
1031            if log_name == rel.replace("\\", "_").replace("/", "_") + ".o.log":
1032                self._set_owner(target, package, path)
1033                return
1034
1035    def _record(self, target: Target, diag: Diagnostic):
1036        if diag.message in target.messages:  # fpm echoes the log on failure
1037            return
1038        target.messages.append(diag.message)
1039        target.diagnostics.append(diag)
1040        severity = diag.severity
1041        if severity in ("error", "fatal error"):
1042            target.errors += 1
1043            self._mark_failed(target)
1044        elif severity == "warning":
1045            target.warnings += 1
1046            if target.status in (DONE, WARNING):
1047                self._set_status(target, WARNING)
1048        self._update_tooltip(target)
1049        self._header_later()
1050
1051    # ------------------------------------------------------------- helpers
1052    def _find(self, name: str, running: bool) -> Target | None:
1053        """Most suitable row for a file name: the oldest one still compiling,
1054        otherwise (unless ``running``) the most recent one."""
1055        for t in self.targets:
1056            if t.name == name and t.status == COMPILING:
1057                return t
1058        if running:
1059            return None
1060        for t in reversed(self.targets):
1061            if t.name == name:
1062                return t
1063        return None
1064
1065    def _find_object(self, obj: str) -> Target | None:
1066        # fpm names objects after the source path with "/" -> "_", plus ".o".
1067        stem = obj.removesuffix(".o")
1068        candidates = [t for t in self.targets if stem == t.name or stem.endswith("_" + t.name)]
1069        return max(candidates, key=lambda t: len(t.name), default=None)
1070
1071    def _mark_failed(self, target: Target):
1072        if target.finished is None:
1073            target.finished = time.monotonic()
1074        self._set_status(target, FAILED)

1076    def _add(self, name: str) -> Target:
1077        row = self.table.rowCount()
1078        self.table.insertRow(row)
1079        target = Target(name, row, seq=len(self.targets))
1080        self.targets.append(target)
1081        for column in range(len(self.COLUMNS)):
1082            self.table.setItem(row, column, QTableWidgetItem())
1083
1084        kind = target_kind(name)
1085        self.table.item(row, 0).setText(name)
1086        self.table.item(row, 0).setToolTip(kind)
1087        if kind == "Source":
1088            target.candidates = self.sources.get(name, [])
1089            if len(target.candidates) == 1:
1090                self._set_owner(target, *target.candidates[0])
1091            else:
1092                names = sorted({p for p, _ in target.candidates})
1093                target.package = ", ".join(names)
1094                target.package_kind = self.package_kinds.get(names[0], LIBRARY) if names else LIBRARY
1095        else:
1096            target.package = kind.lower()
1097            target.package_kind = LIBRARY
1098        self._set_status(target, COMPILING)
1099        running = sum(1 for t in self.targets if t.status == COMPILING)
1100        self.peak_parallel = max(self.peak_parallel, running)
1101        self._apply_filter(target)
1102        if not self.table.isRowHidden(row):
1103            self.table.scrollToItem(self.table.item(row, 0))
1104        self.schedule_sort()
1105        return target

1183    def _header_later(self):
1184        """The header brought up to date once the lines that have come in are

1186        counting every row and laying out the header's text held the window)."""

1191    def update_header(self):
1192        self._header_pending = False
1193        pal = self.palette_colors
1194        parts = [self.description] if self.description else []
1195        if self.peak_parallel > 1:
1196            parts.append(f"{self.peak_parallel} parallel")
1197        self.subtitle.setText(f"<span style='color:{pal['muted']}'>{' · '.join(parts)}</span>")
1198
1199        counts = self.counts()
1200        for status, chip in self.chips.items():
1201            chip.setText(f"{STATUS_ICONS[status]} {counts[status]}")
1202            chip.setVisible(counts[status] > 0)
1203        if self.filter_status and counts[self.filter_status] == 0:
1204            self.set_filter(None)
1205
1206        end = self._finished_at or time.monotonic()
1207        seconds = f"{end - self._started:.1f} s" if self._started else ""
1208        finished = counts[DONE] + counts[WARNING]
1209        muted = f"<span style='color:{pal['muted']}'>"
1210        if self._result in ("uptodate", "ok") and not self.targets:  # nothing needed compiling
1211            text = "<b>Up to date</b>"
1212        elif self._result == "ok":
1213            text = f"<b>Finished</b> {muted}· {finished} built · {seconds}</span>"
1214        elif self._result == "failed":
1215            text = f"<b>Failed at {self._percent}%</b> {muted}· {seconds}</span>"
1216        elif self._result == "stopped":
1217            text = f"<b>Stopped at {self._percent}%</b> {muted}· {seconds}</span>"
1218        elif self._active:
1219            text = f"<b>{self._percent}%</b> {muted}· {finished} done · {seconds}</span>"
1220        else:
1221            text = f"{muted}Run Build, Run or Test to see progress</span>"
1222        self.progress_label.setText(text)
1223        self._update_empty()

1225    def _update_empty(self):
1226        """While nothing has been compiled, a message instead of the table."""
1227        if self.table.rowCount():
1228            message = ""
1229        elif self._result == "uptodate" or (self._result == "ok" and not self.targets):
1230            message = "Nothing needed compiling — the project is up to date."
1231        elif self._result in ("failed", "stopped"):
1232            message = "Nothing was compiled — see the output."
1233        elif self._active:
1234            message = "Waiting for fpm…"
1235        else:
1236            message = "Run Build, Run or Test to see each file fpm compiles here."
1237        if self.empty.text() != message:
1238            self.empty.setText(message)
1239        self.empty.setVisible(bool(message))
1240        self.table.setVisible(not message)

1246        self.table.viewport().update()  # also clears the last flash frame
1247        self.update_header()

GNU_SEVERITY_RE = re.compile('^(Fatal Error|Error|Warning):\\s*(.*)$')
LFORTRAN_SEVERITY_RE = re.compile('^(?:[a-z]+ )?(error|warning|style suggestion):\\s*(.*)$')
LFORTRAN_LOC_RE = re.compile('^\\s*-->\\s*((?:[A-Za-z]:)?.+?):(\\d+)(?::\\d+)?\\s*$')
FAILED_OBJECT_RE = re.compile('Compilation failed for object\\s+"\\s*(.+?)\\s*"')
UP_TO_DATE_RE = re.compile('Project is up to date')

class DiagnosticParser: 
129class DiagnosticParser:
130    """Turns compiler output, one line at a time, into `Diagnostic`."""
131
132    def __init__(self):
133        self._location: tuple[str, int] | None = None  # gfortran prints the severity later
134        self._pending: tuple[str, str] | None = None  # lfortran prints the location later
135
136    def feed(self, line: str) -> Diagnostic | None:
137        match = LFORTRAN_SEVERITY_RE.match(line)
138        if match:
139            severity = "remark" if match.group(1) == "style suggestion" else match.group(1)
140            self._pending = (severity, line)
141            return None
142        if self._pending:
143            match = LFORTRAN_LOC_RE.match(line)
144            if match:
145                (severity, text), self._pending = self._pending, None
146                return Diagnostic(match.group(1), int(match.group(2)), severity,
147                                  f"{match.group(1)}:{match.group(2)}: {text}")
148        match = INTEL_LOC_RE.match(line)
149        if match:
150            return Diagnostic(match.group(1), int(match.group(2)), match.group(3).lower(), line)
151        match = GNU_LOC_RE.match(line)
152        if match and Path(match.group(1)).suffix.lower() in SOURCE_EXTS:
153            if match.group(4):  # severity on the same line (gcc/clang style)
154                return Diagnostic(match.group(1), int(match.group(2)), match.group(4).lower(), line)
155            self._location = (match.group(1), int(match.group(2)))
156            return None
157        match = GNU_SEVERITY_RE.match(line)
158        if match and self._location:
159            (file, number), self._location = self._location, None
160            return Diagnostic(file, number, match.group(1).lower(), f"{file}:{number}: {line}")
161        return None

LOG_READ_LIMIT = 1000000
def read_log_text(log: pathlib.Path) -> str: 
167def read_log_text(log: Path) -> str:
168    """A compiler log's text. A huge one (an lfortran crash writes the whole
169    compiled program, 100+ MB) is read as its start and end only, which is
170    where the messages are; reading and showing all of it would freeze the app."""
171    size = log.stat().st_size
172    if size <= LOG_READ_LIMIT:
173        return log.read_text(errors="replace")
174    half = LOG_READ_LIMIT // 2
175    with open(log, "rb") as f:
176        head = f.read(half)
177        f.seek(size - half)
178        tail = f.read()
179    head = head[:head.rfind(b"\n") + 1] or head  # whole lines only
180    tail = tail[tail.find(b"\n") + 1:] or tail
181    skipped = size - len(head) - len(tail)
182    return (head.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
183            + f"\n[… {skipped / 1e6:.1f} MB of compiler output not shown — full log: {log} …]\n\n"
184            + tail.decode("utf-8", errors="replace"))

A compiler log's text. A huge one (an lfortran crash writes the whole compiled program, 100+ MB) is read as its start and end only, which is where the messages are; reading and showing all of it would freeze the app.

def index_sources( graph: vibefpmgui.manifest.DependencyGraph | None) -> dict[str, list[tuple[str, pathlib.Path]]]: 
218def index_sources(graph: m.DependencyGraph | None) -> dict[str, list[tuple[str, Path]]]:
219    """Map source file basename -> [(package, full path)] for every package
220    on disk, so table rows can say which package a file belongs to."""
221    index: dict[str, list[tuple[str, Path]]] = {}
222    if graph is None:
223        return index
224    packages = [p for p in graph.packages.values()
225                if p.directory and p.directory.is_dir() and p.kind != m.MISSING]
226    package_dirs = {p.directory.resolve() for p in packages}
227    for pkg in packages:
228        own = pkg.directory.resolve()
229        for dirpath, dirnames, filenames in os.walk(own):
230            # Skip build trees (they hold other packages' sources), VCS dirs,
231            # and nested packages (e.g. a path dependency inside the project),
232            # which are indexed under their own name.
233            dirnames[:] = [d for d in dirnames if d != "build" and not d.startswith(".")
234                           and (Path(dirpath) / d).resolve() not in package_dirs]
235            for f in filenames:
236                if Path(f).suffix.lower() in SOURCE_EXTS:
237                    index.setdefault(f, []).append((pkg.name, Path(dirpath) / f))
238    return index

Map source file basename -> [(package, full path)] for every package on disk, so table rows can say which package a file belongs to.

def paint_name_and_detail( p: PySide6.QtGui.QPainter, r: PySide6.QtCore.QRectF, name: str, detail: str, bold: PySide6.QtGui.QFont, small: PySide6.QtGui.QFont, color: PySide6.QtGui.QColor, muted: PySide6.QtGui.QColor, detail_elide=<TextElideMode.ElideRight: 1>): 
292def paint_name_and_detail(p: QPainter, r: QRectF, name: str, detail: str, bold: QFont, small: QFont,
293                          color: QColor, muted: QColor, detail_elide=Qt.ElideRight):
294    """A row's name (bold) and, on the same line after it, its detail in
295    small grey text (a file's folder, a test's exit code), each shortened
296    to fit: the name keeps at least 60% of the room when both don't fit."""
297    gap = 8
298    name_metrics = QFontMetricsF(bold)
299    name_width = name_metrics.horizontalAdvance(name)
300    if detail:
301        detail_width = QFontMetricsF(small).horizontalAdvance(detail)
302        if name_width + gap + detail_width > r.width():
303            name_width = min(name_width, max(r.width() * 0.6, r.width() - gap - detail_width))
304    shown = name_metrics.elidedText(name, Qt.ElideMiddle, min(name_width, r.width()) + 1)
305    p.setFont(bold)
306    p.setPen(color)
307    p.drawText(r, Qt.AlignLeft | Qt.AlignVCenter, shown)
308    if not detail:
309        return
310    left = r.left() + name_metrics.horizontalAdvance(shown) + gap
311    room = r.right() - left
312    if room < 20:
313        return
314    p.setFont(small)
315    p.setPen(muted)
316    p.drawText(QRectF(left, r.top(), room, r.height()), Qt.AlignLeft | Qt.AlignVCenter,
317               QFontMetricsF(small).elidedText(detail, detail_elide, room))

A row's name (bold) and, on the same line after it, its detail in small grey text (a file's folder, a test's exit code), each shortened to fit: the name keeps at least 60% of the room when both don't fit.

class RowDelegate(PySide6.QtWidgets.QStyledItemDelegate): 
320class RowDelegate(QStyledItemDelegate):
321    """Paints every cell of the build table from its `Target`."""
322
323    def __init__(self, monitor: BuildMonitor):
324        super().__init__(monitor.table)
325        self.monitor = monitor
326
327    def sizeHint(self, option, index):
328        return QSize(100, scaled(COMPACT_ROW_HEIGHT))
329
330    def paint(self, p: QPainter, option, index):
331        mon = self.monitor
332        if index.row() >= len(mon.targets):
333            return
334        target = mon.targets[index.row()]
335        pal = mon.palette_colors
336        r = QRectF(option.rect)
337        p.save()
338        p.setRenderHint(QPainter.Antialiasing)
339        status_color = QColor(pal["status"][target.status])
340
341        if index.row() == mon.selected_row:
342            p.fillRect(r, _tint(QColor(pal["accent1"]), 28))
343            if index.column() == 0:
344                p.fillRect(QRectF(r.left(), r.top() + 6, 3, r.height() - 12), QColor(pal["accent1"]))
345        elif index.row() == mon.hover_row:
346            p.fillRect(r, QColor(pal["hover"]))
347        if target.finished is not None:  # fade-out flash when a file finishes
348            age = time.monotonic() - target.finished
349            if age < FLASH_SECONDS:
350                p.fillRect(r, _tint(status_color, int(35 * (1 - age / FLASH_SECONDS))))
351        p.setPen(QPen(QColor(pal["line"]), 1))
352        p.drawLine(r.bottomLeft(), r.bottomRight())
353
354        small = QFont(option.font)
355        small.setPointSizeF(max(option.font.pointSizeF() - 2, 7))
356        column = index.column()
357        if column == 0:
358            self._paint_file(p, r, target, option.font, small, pal)
359        elif column == 1:
360            self._paint_package(p, r, target, small, pal)
361        elif column == 2:
362            self._paint_status(p, r, target, small, pal, status_color)
363        else:
364            self._paint_time(p, r, target, small, pal, status_color)
365        p.restore()
366
367    def _paint_file(self, p, r, target, font, small, pal):
368        bold = QFont(font)
369        bold.setWeight(QFont.DemiBold)
370        paint_name_and_detail(p, r.adjusted(14, 0, -6, 0), target.name, self.monitor.display_folder(target),
371                              bold, small, QColor(pal["text"]), QColor(pal["muted"]), Qt.ElideLeft)
372
373    def _paint_package(self, p, r, target, small, pal):
374        if not target.package:
375            return
376        color = QColor(self.monitor.package_colors.get(target.package_kind, pal["muted"]))
377        fm = QFontMetricsF(small)
378        text = fm.elidedText(target.package, Qt.ElideRight, r.width() - 46)
379        pill = QRectF(r.left() + 8, r.center().y() - 9, fm.horizontalAdvance(text) + 28, 18)
380        p.setPen(Qt.NoPen)
381        p.setBrush(_tint(color, 50))
382        p.drawRoundedRect(pill, 9, 9)
383        p.setBrush(color)
384        p.drawEllipse(QRectF(pill.left() + 7, pill.center().y() - 3, 6, 6))
385        p.setFont(small)
386        p.setPen(QColor(pal["text"]))
387        p.drawText(pill.adjusted(17, 0, 0, 0), Qt.AlignVCenter | Qt.AlignLeft, text)
388
389    def _paint_status(self, p, r, target, small, pal, color):
390        text = f"{target.warnings} warning{'s' * (target.warnings != 1)}" \
391            if target.status == WARNING else target.status
392        font = QFont(small)
393        font.setWeight(QFont.DemiBold)
394        pill = QRectF(r.left() + 8, r.center().y() - 10,
395                      QFontMetricsF(font).horizontalAdvance(text) + 36, 20)
396        p.setPen(Qt.NoPen)
397        p.setBrush(_tint(color, 40))
398        p.drawRoundedRect(pill, 10, 10)
399        icon = QRectF(pill.left() + 8, pill.center().y() - 6, 12, 12)
400        if target.status == COMPILING:  # spinning arc
401            p.setPen(QPen(_tint(color, 70), 2))
402            p.drawEllipse(icon)
403            p.setPen(QPen(color, 2, Qt.SolidLine, Qt.RoundCap))
404            p.drawArc(icon, int(-self.monitor.spinner_angle * 16), -110 * 16)
405        else:
406            p.setFont(font)
407            p.setPen(color)
408            p.drawText(icon.adjusted(-3, -3, 3, 3), Qt.AlignCenter, STATUS_ICONS[target.status])
409        p.setFont(font)
410        p.setPen(color.darker(115) if self.monitor.is_light else color)
411        p.drawText(pill.adjusted(27, 0, -6, 0), Qt.AlignVCenter | Qt.AlignLeft, text)
412
413    def _paint_time(self, p, r, target, small, pal, color):
414        elapsed = target.elapsed()
415        slowest = self.monitor.slowest()
416        track = QRectF(r.left() + 10, r.center().y() - 3, max(r.width() - 74, 10), 6)
417        p.setPen(Qt.NoPen)
418        p.setBrush(QColor(pal["track"]))
419        p.drawRoundedRect(track, 3, 3)
420        # Live bars use the status color; finished ones are grey.
421        bar_color = color if target.status == COMPILING else QColor(pal["muted"])
422        fraction = elapsed / slowest if slowest > 0 else 0
423        p.setBrush(bar_color)
424        p.drawRoundedRect(QRectF(track.left(), track.top(), max(track.width() * fraction, 3), 6), 3, 3)
425        mono = QFontDatabase.systemFont(QFontDatabase.FixedFont)
426        mono.setPointSizeF(small.pointSizeF())
427        p.setFont(mono)
428        p.setPen(QColor(pal["text"] if target.status == COMPILING else pal["muted"]))
429        p.drawText(r.adjusted(0, 0, -12, 0), Qt.AlignVCenter | Qt.AlignRight, f"{elapsed:.1f} s")

Paints every cell of the build table from its Target.

class SortableTable: 
432class SortableTable:
433    """Click-to-sort for the custom-drawn status tables.
434
435    The delegates paint row *n* from ``rows()[n]``, so instead of Qt's own
436    sorting (which would reorder the items but not our list) the list itself
437    is sorted and every row's items are rewritten. Clicking a header cycles
438    through: sorted, reversed, original order. The order is kept while rows
439    are added or change (re-sorted a few times a second at most).
440
441    Subclasses provide ``table``, ``COLUMNS``, ``rows()``, ``_sync_row(i)``
442    and ``_reapply_filter()``, and may override ``_selected_object`` /
443    ``_restore_selection`` to keep the selection on the same object.
444    """
445
446    def _init_sorting(self, keys: dict, descending_first: set[int] = frozenset()):
447        self._sort_keys = keys
448        self._sort_desc_first = set(descending_first)
449        self.sort_column = -1
450        self.sort_descending = False
451        self._sort_clicks = 0
452        header = self.table.horizontalHeader()
453        header.setSectionsClickable(True)
454        header.sectionClicked.connect(self._header_clicked)
455        self._sort_timer = QTimer(self)
456        self._sort_timer.setSingleShot(True)
457        self._sort_timer.setInterval(150)
458        self._sort_timer.timeout.connect(self.apply_sort)
459        for column in keys:
460            item = self.table.horizontalHeaderItem(column)
461            if item is not None:
462                item.setToolTip("Click to sort (again to reverse, a third time for the original order)")
463
464    def _header_clicked(self, column: int):
465        if column not in self._sort_keys:
466            return
467        if column != self.sort_column:
468            self.sort_column = column
469            self.sort_descending = column in self._sort_desc_first
470            self._sort_clicks = 1
471        elif self._sort_clicks == 1:
472            self.sort_descending = not self.sort_descending
473            self._sort_clicks = 2
474        else:
475            self.sort_column = -1  # back to the original order
476            self._sort_clicks = 0
477        self.apply_sort()
478
479    def schedule_sort(self):
480        """Call when rows were added or changed; re-sorts shortly if sorted."""
481        if self.sort_column >= 0 and not self._sort_timer.isActive():
482            self._sort_timer.start()
483
484    def apply_sort(self):
485        rows = self.rows()
486        selected = self._selected_object()
487        rows.sort(key=lambda o: getattr(o, "seq", 0))  # stable base: original order
488        if self.sort_column >= 0:
489            rows.sort(key=self._sort_keys[self.sort_column], reverse=self.sort_descending)
490        for index, obj in enumerate(rows):
491            if hasattr(obj, "row"):
492                obj.row = index
493            self._sync_row(index)
494        self._restore_selection(selected)
495        self._reapply_filter()
496        self._update_sort_header()
497        self.table.viewport().update()
498
499    def _update_sort_header(self):
500        labels = []
501        for column, name in enumerate(self.COLUMNS):
502            if column == self.sort_column:
503                name += " ▼" if self.sort_descending else " ▲"
504            labels.append(name)
505        self.table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(labels)
506
507    def _selected_object(self):
508        row = getattr(self, "selected_row", -1)
509        rows = self.rows()
510        return rows[row] if 0 <= row < len(rows) else None
511
512    def _restore_selection(self, obj):
513        if hasattr(self, "selected_row"):
514            self.selected_row = self.rows().index(obj) if obj is not None else -1

class ProgressLine(PySide6.QtWidgets.QWidget): 
517class ProgressLine(QWidget):
518    """Thin rounded progress bar with a gradient fill. In "busy" mode
519    (`set_busy`) it shows a segment sliding back and forth instead of
520    a fill, for work whose length isn't known."""
521
522    SEGMENT = 0.28  # busy segment width, as a fraction of the bar
523
524    def __init__(self, monitor: BuildMonitor):
525        super().__init__()
526        self.monitor = monitor
527        self.value = 0.0
528        self.state = "running"  # running | ok | failed | stopped
529        self.busy = False
530        self._busy_started = 0.0
531        self._busy_timer = QTimer(self)
532        self._busy_timer.setInterval(16)
533        self._busy_timer.timeout.connect(self.update)
534        self.setFixedHeight(6)
535
536    def set(self, value: float, state: str | None = None):
537        """Show a known fraction (0..1); ends busy mode."""
538        self._stop_busy()
539        self.value = max(0.0, min(1.0, value))
540        if state:
541            self.state = state
542        self.update()
543
544    def set_busy(self, busy: bool = True):
545        """Indeterminate mode: something is happening, amount unknown."""
546        if busy and not self.busy:
547            self.busy = True
548            self.state = "running"
549            self._busy_started = time.monotonic()
550            self._busy_timer.start()
551        elif not busy:
552            self._stop_busy()
553        self.update()
554
555    def _stop_busy(self):
556        self.busy = False
557        self._busy_timer.stop()
558
559    def paintEvent(self, _event):
560        pal = self.monitor.palette_colors
561        p = QPainter(self)
562        p.setRenderHint(QPainter.Antialiasing)
563        r = QRectF(self.rect())
564        p.setPen(Qt.NoPen)
565        p.setBrush(QColor(pal["track"]))
566        p.drawRoundedRect(r, 3, 3)
567        if self.busy:
568            self._paint_busy(p, r, pal)
569            return
570        if self.value <= 0:
571            return
572        if self.state == "failed":
573            a = b = QColor(pal["status"][FAILED])
574        elif self.state == "stopped":
575            a = b = QColor(pal["status"][ABORTED])
576        elif self.state == "ok":
577            a = b = QColor(pal["status"][DONE])
578        else:
579            a, b = QColor(pal["accent1"]), QColor(pal["accent2"])
580        gradient = QLinearGradient(r.topLeft(), r.topRight())
581        gradient.setColorAt(0, a)
582        gradient.setColorAt(1, b)
583        p.setBrush(gradient)
584        p.drawRoundedRect(QRectF(r.left(), r.top(), max(r.width() * self.value, 6), r.height()), 3, 3)
585
586    def _paint_busy(self, p: QPainter, r: QRectF, pal: dict):
587        # Ease back and forth across the track, ~1.6 s per sweep.
588        t = ((time.monotonic() - self._busy_started) / 1.6) % 2.0
589        t = t if t <= 1 else 2 - t
590        t = t * t * (3 - 2 * t)  # smoothstep
591        seg = r.width() * self.SEGMENT
592        x = r.left() + (r.width() - seg) * t
593        gradient = QLinearGradient(x, 0, x + seg, 0)
594        a, b = QColor(pal["accent1"]), QColor(pal["accent2"])
595        edge = QColor(a)
596        edge.setAlpha(0)
597        gradient.setColorAt(0, edge)
598        gradient.setColorAt(0.3, a)
599        gradient.setColorAt(0.7, b)
600        end = QColor(b)
601        end.setAlpha(0)
602        gradient.setColorAt(1, end)
603        p.setBrush(gradient)
604        p.drawRoundedRect(QRectF(x, r.top(), seg, r.height()), 3, 3)

Thin rounded progress bar with a gradient fill. In "busy" mode (set_busy) it shows a segment sliding back and forth instead of a fill, for work whose length isn't known.

611class LogFinder:
612    """Finds a source file's compile log, which fpm writes as
613    ``build/<compiler>_<hash>/<package>/<source path>.o.log``: the path is
614    relative to the project, with "/" as "_" (``src_utils.f90.o.log``,
615    ``build_dependencies_fmin_src_fmin.F90.o.log``). There is a folder per
616    compiler and flag combination, and a build may create new ones.
617
618    Called for each file a build finishes, so it doesn't list folders: it
619    checks for the names the file's known paths give (one stat per folder).
620    Only when that finds nothing (the path isn't known) does it list the
621    folders, and each listing is kept until its folder changes."""
622
623    def __init__(self, project_dir: Path):
624        self.project_dir = project_dir
625        self._root = project_dir.resolve()
626        self.build = project_dir / "build"
627        self._folders: tuple[tuple, list[Path]] = ((), [])  # (what they were listed from, the folders)
628        self._listings: dict[Path, tuple[int, dict[str, list[str]]]] = {}  # folder -> (its mtime, its logs by tail)
629        self._resolved: dict[Path, Path] = {}  # (a source's path, resolved once)
630        self.listed = 0  # folders listed (for the tests)
631
632    def folders(self) -> list[Path]:
633        """``build/*_*/*``: listed again only when a folder is added or removed."""
634        try:
635            configs = sorted(e.path for e in os.scandir(self.build) if e.is_dir() and "_" in e.name)
636            key = (self.build.stat().st_mtime_ns, *((c, os.stat(c).st_mtime_ns) for c in configs))
637        except OSError:
638            return []
639        if key != self._folders[0]:
640            folders = []
641            for config in configs:
642                try:
643                    folders += [Path(e.path) for e in os.scandir(config) if e.is_dir()]
644                except OSError:
645                    continue
646            self._folders = (key, folders)
647        return self._folders[1]
648
649    def log_names(self, name: str, paths: list[Path]) -> list[str]:
650        """The log names fpm would give a file with this name and these paths."""
651        names = [f"{name}.o.log"]
652        for path in paths:
653            resolved = self._resolved.get(path)
654            if resolved is None:
655                resolved = self._resolved[path] = Path(path).resolve()
656            try:
657                rel = os.path.relpath(resolved, self._root)
658            except ValueError:  # (Windows: another drive)
659                continue
660            names.append(rel.replace("\\", "_").replace("/", "_") + ".o.log")
661        return names
662
663    def find(self, name: str, paths: list[Path], since: float) -> list[tuple[float, Path]]:
664        """(modification time, log) of the logs for a source file written
665        since ``since`` (the build's start)."""
666        folders = self.folders()
667        found = []
668        log_names = self.log_names(name, paths)
669        for folder in folders:
670            for log_name in log_names:
671                found += self._if_new(folder / log_name, since)
672        if found:
673            return found
674        own = f"{name}.o.log"
675        for folder in folders:  # (not found by its path, or that isn't known: any log of that file name)
676            for log_name in self._listing(folder).get(_tail(own), ()):
677                if log_name == own or log_name.endswith(f"_{own}"):
678                    found += self._if_new(folder / log_name, since)
679        return found
680
681    @staticmethod
682    def _if_new(log: Path, since: float) -> list[tuple[float, Path]]:
683        try:
684            mtime = log.stat().st_mtime
685        except OSError:
686            return []
687        return [(mtime, log)] if mtime >= since else []
688
689    def _listing(self, folder: Path) -> dict[str, list[str]]:
690        """The folder's logs, by their names' tails (see `_tail`): a file's
691        are under its own name's tail, so they're found without going
692        through every log of a big build."""
693        try:
694            mtime = folder.stat().st_mtime_ns
695        except OSError:
696            return {}
697        cached = self._listings.get(folder)
698        if cached is None or cached[0] != mtime:
699            self.listed += 1
700            by_tail: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
701            try:
702                for entry in os.scandir(folder):
703                    if entry.name.endswith(".o.log"):
704                        by_tail.setdefault(_tail(entry.name), []).append(entry.name)
705            except OSError:
706                pass
707            cached = self._listings[folder] = (mtime, by_tail)
708        return cached[1]

There is a folder per compiler and flag combination, and a build may create new ones.

 879    # ----------------------------------------------------------- lifecycle
 880    def start(self, graph: m.DependencyGraph | None, project_dir: Path, description: str = ""):
 881        self.targets.clear()
 882        self.selected_row = -1
 883        self.table.setRowCount(0)
 884        self.sources = index_sources(graph)
 885        self.package_kinds = {n: p.kind for n, p in graph.packages.items()} if graph else {}
 886        self.diagnostics = DiagnosticParser()
 887        self.project_dir = project_dir
 888        self._logs = LogFinder(project_dir)  # (fresh for each build: new folders)
 889        self.description = description
 890        self.peak_parallel = 0
 891        self._build_started = time.time()
 892        self._started = time.monotonic()
 893        self._finished_at = None
 894        self._percent = 0
 895        self._result = ""
 896        self._active = True
 897        self.set_filter(None)
 898        self.progress.set(0, "running")
 899        self._timer.start()
 900        self.update_header()
 901
 902    def reset(self):
 903        """Back to the empty state (e.g. when another project is opened)."""
 904        self._timer.stop()
 905        self.targets.clear()
 906        self.selected_row = -1
 907        self.table.setRowCount(0)
 908        self.project_dir = None
 909        self.description = ""
 910        self.peak_parallel = 0
 911        self._started = 0.0
 912        self._finished_at = None
 913        self._percent = 0
 914        self._result = ""
 915        self._active = False
 916        self.set_filter(None)
 917        self.progress.set(0, "running")
 918        self.update_header()
