 920    @property
 921    def percent(self) -> int:
 922        """How far the build is (0–100)."""
 923        return self._percent
 924
 925    def finish(self, exit_code: int, stopped: bool = False):
 926        if not self._active:
 927            return
 928        self._active = False
 929        self._finished_at = time.monotonic()
 930        for t in self.targets:
 931            if t.status == COMPILING:
 932                # A sibling's failure (or Stop) kills files still compiling.
 933                t.finished = self._finished_at
 934                self._set_status(t, ABORTED if (stopped or exit_code != 0) else DONE)
 935        if stopped:
 936            self._result = "stopped"
 937        elif exit_code != 0:
 938            self._result = "failed"
 939        elif self._result != "uptodate" or self.targets:
 940            self._result = "ok"
 941            self._percent = 100
 942        self.progress.set(self._percent / 100, {"uptodate": "ok"}.get(self._result, self._result))
 943        self.update_header()
 944        self.table.viewport().update()
 945
 946    # ------------------------------------------------------------- parsing
 947    def feed_line(self, line: str):
 948        """Process one complete line of fpm output."""
 949        if not self._active:
 950            return
 951        line = line.rstrip()
 952        if not line:
 953            return
 954
 955        match = PROGRESS_RE.match(line)
 956        if match:
 957            percent, name, end = int(match.group(1)), match.group(2).strip(), match.group(3)
 958            self._percent = max(self._percent, percent)
 959            self.progress.set(self._percent / 100)
 960            if end:
 961                target = self._find(name, running=True) or self._add(name)
 962                if target.status == COMPILING:
 963                    target.finished = time.monotonic()
 964                    self._read_log(target)
 965                    self._set_status(target, FAILED if end == "failed" or target.errors
 966                                     else WARNING if target.warnings else DONE)
 967            else:
 968                self._add(name)
 969            self._header_later()
 970            return
 971
 972        match = FAILED_OBJECT_RE.search(line)
 973        if match:
 974            target = self._find_object(match.group(1))
 975            if target:
 976                self._mark_failed(target)
 977            self._header_later()
 978            return
 979
 980        if UP_TO_DATE_RE.search(line):
 981            self._percent = 100
 982            self._result = "uptodate"
 983            self.progress.set(1.0, "ok")
 984            self.update_header()
 985            return
 986
 987        self._parse_diagnostic(line)
 988
 989    def _parse_diagnostic(self, line: str):
 990        found = self.diagnostics.feed(line)
 991        if found:
 992            target = self._find(Path(found.file).name, running=False)
 993            if target:
 994                self._record(target, found)
 995
 996    def _read_log(self, target: Target):
 997        """Pick up diagnostics for a finished source file from fpm's log."""
 998        if target_kind(target.name) != "Source":
 999            return
1000        if self.project_dir is None:
1001            return
1002        if self._logs is None or self._logs.project_dir != self.project_dir:
1003            self._logs = LogFinder(self.project_dir)
1004        logs = self._logs.find(target.name, [path for _package, path in target.candidates], self._build_started)
1005        if not logs:
1006            return
1007        log = max(logs)[1]
1008        self._resolve_owner(target, log.name)
1009        try:
1010            text = read_log_text(log)
1011        except OSError:
1012            return
1013        target.log_text = text  # shown with its colors
1014        parser = DiagnosticParser()
1015        for line in strip_ansi(text).splitlines():
1016            found = parser.feed(line.rstrip())
1017            if found:
1018                # Diagnostics in included files still belong to this target.
1019                self._record(target, found)
1020
1021    def _resolve_owner(self, target: Target, log_name: str):
1022        """Several packages may have a file of this name; fpm names the log
1023        after the source path relative to the project ("/" -> "_"), which
1024        tells them apart."""
1025        if len(target.candidates) < 2 or self.project_dir is None:
1026            return
1027        for package, path in target.candidates:
1028            try:
1029                rel = os.path.relpath(path, self.project_dir)
1030            except ValueError:
1031                continue
1032            if log_name == rel.replace("\\", "_").replace("/", "_") + ".o.log":
1033                self._set_owner(target, package, path)
1034                return
1035
1036    def _record(self, target: Target, diag: Diagnostic):
1037        if diag.message in target.messages:  # fpm echoes the log on failure
1038            return
1039        target.messages.append(diag.message)
1040        target.diagnostics.append(diag)
1041        severity = diag.severity
1042        if severity in ("error", "fatal error"):
1043            target.errors += 1
1044            self._mark_failed(target)
1045        elif severity == "warning":
1046            target.warnings += 1
1047            if target.status in (DONE, WARNING):
1048                self._set_status(target, WARNING)
1049        self._update_tooltip(target)
1050        self._header_later()
1051
1052    # ------------------------------------------------------------- helpers
1053    def _find(self, name: str, running: bool) -> Target | None:
1054        """Most suitable row for a file name: the oldest one still compiling,
1055        otherwise (unless ``running``) the most recent one."""
1056        for t in self.targets:
1057            if t.name == name and t.status == COMPILING:
1058                return t
1059        if running:
1060            return None
1061        for t in reversed(self.targets):
1062            if t.name == name:
1063                return t
1064        return None
1065
1066    def _find_object(self, obj: str) -> Target | None:
1067        # fpm names objects after the source path with "/" -> "_", plus ".o".
1068        stem = obj.removesuffix(".o")
1069        candidates = [t for t in self.targets if stem == t.name or stem.endswith("_" + t.name)]
1070        return max(candidates, key=lambda t: len(t.name), default=None)
1071
1072    def _mark_failed(self, target: Target):
1073        if target.finished is None:
1074            target.finished = time.monotonic()
1075        self._set_status(target, FAILED)
1076
1077    def _add(self, name: str) -> Target:
1078        row = self.table.rowCount()
1079        self.table.insertRow(row)
1080        target = Target(name, row, seq=len(self.targets))
1081        self.targets.append(target)
1082        for column in range(len(self.COLUMNS)):
1083            self.table.setItem(row, column, QTableWidgetItem())
1084
1085        kind = target_kind(name)
1086        self.table.item(row, 0).setText(name)
1087        self.table.item(row, 0).setToolTip(kind)
1088        if kind == "Source":
1089            target.candidates = self.sources.get(name, [])
1090            if len(target.candidates) == 1:
1091                self._set_owner(target, *target.candidates[0])
1092            else:
1093                names = sorted({p for p, _ in target.candidates})
1094                target.package = ", ".join(names)
1095                target.package_kind = self.package_kinds.get(names[0], LIBRARY) if names else LIBRARY
1096        else:
1097            target.package = kind.lower()
1098            target.package_kind = LIBRARY
1099        self._set_status(target, COMPILING)
1100        running = sum(1 for t in self.targets if t.status == COMPILING)
1101        self.peak_parallel = max(self.peak_parallel, running)
1102        self._apply_filter(target)
1103        if not self.table.isRowHidden(row):
1104            self.table.scrollToItem(self.table.item(row, 0))
1105        self.schedule_sort()
1106        return target
1107
1108    def _set_owner(self, target: Target, package: str, path: Path):
1109        target.package = package
1110        target.package_kind = self.package_kinds.get(package, LIBRARY)
1111        target.path = path
1112        item = self.table.item(target.row, 0)
1113        item.setData(Qt.UserRole, str(path))
1114        item.setToolTip(str(path))
1115        self.table.item(target.row, 1).setText(package)
1116
1117    def display_folder(self, target: Target) -> str:
1118        if target.path is None:
1119            return ""
1120        folder = target.path.parent
1121        if self.project_dir is not None:
1122            try:
1123                return os.path.relpath(folder, self.project_dir)
1124            except ValueError:
1125                pass
1126        return str(folder)
1127
1128    def _set_status(self, target: Target, status: str):
1129        target.status = status
1130        self.table.item(target.row, 2).setText(status)
1131        self._apply_filter(target)
1132        self.table.viewport().update()
1133        self.schedule_sort()
1134
1135    # SortableTable hooks
1136    def rows(self) -> list[Target]:
1137        return self.targets
1138
1139    def _sync_row(self, row: int):
1140        """Rewrite a row's items (text, tooltips, data) from its target."""
1141        t = self.targets[row]
1142        file_item = self.table.item(row, 0)
1143        file_item.setText(t.name)
1144        file_item.setToolTip(str(t.path) if t.path else target_kind(t.name))
1145        file_item.setData(Qt.UserRole, str(t.path) if t.path else None)
1146        self.table.item(row, 1).setText(t.package)
1147        status_item = self.table.item(row, 2)
1148        status_item.setText(t.status)
1149        status_item.setToolTip("")
1150        self._update_tooltip(t)
1151
1152    def _reapply_filter(self):
1153        for t in self.targets:
1154            self._apply_filter(t)
1155
1156    def _update_tooltip(self, target: Target):
1157        if target.messages:
1158            text = "\n".join(target.messages[:10])
1159            if len(target.messages) > 10:
1160                text += f"\n… {len(target.messages) - 10} more"
1161            self.table.item(target.row, 2).setToolTip(text)
1162
1163    def slowest(self) -> float:
1164        return max((t.elapsed() for t in self.targets), default=0.0)

1166    # ------------------------------------------------------------- display
1167    def set_filter(self, status: str | None):
1168        self.filter_status = status
1169        for s, chip in self.chips.items():
1170            chip.setChecked(s == status)
1171        for t in self.targets:
1172            self._apply_filter(t)
1173
1174    def _apply_filter(self, target: Target):
1175        hide = self.filter_status is not None and target.status != self.filter_status
1176        self.table.setRowHidden(target.row, hide)
1177
1178    def counts(self) -> dict[str, int]:
1179        counts = {s: 0 for s in STATUSES}
1180        for t in self.targets:
1181            counts[t.status] += 1
1182        return counts
1183
1184    def _header_later(self):
1185        """The header brought up to date once the lines that have come in are
1186        all read (not after each: a big build's thousands of lines each
1187        counting every row and laying out the header's text held the window)."""
1188        if not self._header_pending:
1189            self._header_pending = True
1190            QTimer.singleShot(0, self, self.update_header)
1191
1192    def update_header(self):
1193        self._header_pending = False
1194        pal = self.palette_colors
1195        parts = [self.description] if self.description else []
1196        if self.peak_parallel > 1:
1197            parts.append(f"{self.peak_parallel} parallel")
1198        self.subtitle.setText(f"<span style='color:{pal['muted']}'>{' · '.join(parts)}</span>")
1199
1200        counts = self.counts()
1201        for status, chip in self.chips.items():
1202            chip.setText(f"{STATUS_ICONS[status]} {counts[status]}")
1203            chip.setVisible(counts[status] > 0)
1204        if self.filter_status and counts[self.filter_status] == 0:
1205            self.set_filter(None)
1206
1207        end = self._finished_at or time.monotonic()
1208        seconds = f"{end - self._started:.1f} s" if self._started else ""
1209        finished = counts[DONE] + counts[WARNING]
1210        muted = f"<span style='color:{pal['muted']}'>"
1211        if self._result in ("uptodate", "ok") and not self.targets:  # nothing needed compiling
1212            text = "<b>Up to date</b>"
1213        elif self._result == "ok":
1214            text = f"<b>Finished</b> {muted}· {finished} built · {seconds}</span>"
1215        elif self._result == "failed":
1216            text = f"<b>Failed at {self._percent}%</b> {muted}· {seconds}</span>"
1217        elif self._result == "stopped":
1218            text = f"<b>Stopped at {self._percent}%</b> {muted}· {seconds}</span>"
1219        elif self._active:
1220            text = f"<b>{self._percent}%</b> {muted}· {finished} done · {seconds}</span>"
1221        else:
1222            text = f"{muted}Run Build, Run or Test to see progress</span>"
1223        self.progress_label.setText(text)
1224        self._update_empty()
1225
1226    def _update_empty(self):
1227        """While nothing has been compiled, a message instead of the table."""
1228        if self.table.rowCount():
1229            message = ""
1230        elif self._result == "uptodate" or (self._result == "ok" and not self.targets):
1231            message = "Nothing needed compiling — the project is up to date."
1232        elif self._result in ("failed", "stopped"):
1233            message = "Nothing was compiled — see the output."
1234        elif self._active:
1235            message = "Waiting for fpm…"
1236        else:
1237            message = "Run Build, Run or Test to see each file fpm compiles here."
1238        if self.empty.text() != message:
1239            self.empty.setText(message)
1240        self.empty.setVisible(bool(message))
1241        self.table.setVisible(not message)
1242
1243    def _tick(self):
1244        self.spinner_angle = (self.spinner_angle + 18) % 360
1245        now = time.monotonic()
1246        flashing = any(t.finished is not None and now - t.finished < FLASH_SECONDS for t in self.targets)
1247        self.table.viewport().update()  # also clears the last flash frame
1248        self.update_header()
1249        if not (self._active or flashing):
1250            self._timer.stop()
1251
1252    def _set_hover(self, row: int, _column: int):
1253        if row != self.hover_row:
1254            self.hover_row = row
1255            self.table.viewport().update()
1256
1257    def eventFilter(self, obj, event):
1258        if obj is self.table.viewport():
1259            if event.type() == QEvent.Leave:
1260                self._set_hover(-1, 0)
1261            elif event.type() == QEvent.Resize:
1262                self._fit_columns()
1263        return super().eventFilter(obj, event)
1264
1265    def _fit_columns(self):
1266        """Share the width out without a horizontal scrollbar; drop the
1267        package column when space is tight (the file tooltip still has it)."""
1268        width = self.table.viewport().width()
1269        narrow = width < scaled(520)
1270        self.table.setColumnHidden(1, narrow)
1271        self.table.setColumnWidth(1, scaled(130))
1272        self.table.setColumnWidth(2, scaled(140 if width >= scaled(600) else 128))
1273        self.table.setColumnWidth(3, scaled(150 if width >= scaled(700) else 112))
1274
1275    def refresh_fonts(self):
1276        """Re-apply sizes after the application font changed."""
1277        title_font = QFont(QApplication.font())
1278        title_font.setPointSizeF(title_font.pointSizeF() + 2)
1279        title_font.setWeight(QFont.Bold)
1280        self.title.setFont(title_font)
1281        self.table.verticalHeader().setDefaultSectionSize(scaled(COMPACT_ROW_HEIGHT))
1282        self.refresh_palette()  # the stylesheet has pixel sizes
1283        self._fit_columns()
1284
1285    def _row_clicked(self, row: int, _column: int):
1286        """Click a file to see its compiler messages; click again for all output."""
1287        if row >= len(self.targets):
1288            return
1289        self.selected_row = -1 if self.selected_row == row else row
1290        self.table.viewport().update()
1291        self.details_requested.emit(self.selected_row)
1292
1293    def clear_selection(self):
1294        if self.selected_row != -1:
1295            self.selected_row = -1
1296            self.table.viewport().update()
1297
1298    def details_title(self, row: int) -> str:
1299        t = self.targets[row]
1300        what = {WARNING: f"{t.warnings} warning{'s' * (t.warnings != 1)}",
1301                FAILED: "errors"}.get(t.status, t.status.lower())
1302        package = f" ({t.package})" if t.package else ""
1303        return f"{t.name}{package} — {what}"
1304
1305    def details_text(self, row: int) -> str:
1306        """The compiler output for one file, as fpm logged it."""
1307        t = self.targets[row]
1308        if t.status == COMPILING:
1309            return "(still compiling)"
1310        if t.log_text.strip():
1311            return t.log_text
1312        if t.messages:
1313            return "\n".join(t.messages)
1314        return "No compiler messages for this file."
1315
1316    def _open_row(self, row: int, _column: int):
1317        """Double-click: open the source, at its first error or warning."""
1318        path = self.table.item(row, 0).data(Qt.UserRole)
1319        if path:
1320            self.open_file_requested.emit(path, self.diagnostics_for(row))
1321
1322    def _context_menu(self, pos):
1323        row = self.table.rowAt(pos.y())
1324        if not 0 <= row < len(self.targets):
1325            return
1326        target = self.targets[row]
1327        menu = QMenu(self)
1328        if target.path is not None:
1329            path = str(target.path)
1330            menu.addAction("Show Compile Command…", lambda: self.compile_command_requested.emit(path))
1331            menu.addAction("Open in Editor",
1332                           lambda: self.open_file_requested.emit(path, self.diagnostics_for(row)))
1333        menu.addAction("Show Compiler Messages", lambda: self._row_clicked(row, 0)
1334                       if self.selected_row != row else None)
1335        if menu.actions():
1336            menu.exec(self.table.viewport().mapToGlobal(pos))
1337
1338    def diagnostics_for(self, row: int) -> list[Diagnostic]:
1339        """Diagnostics that point into the row's own source file (errors first)."""
1340        t = self.targets[row]
1341        own = [d for d in t.diagnostics if Path(d.file).name == t.name]
1342        return sorted(own, key=lambda d: (d.severity == "warning", d.line))

Per-file compile status: header with filter chips, a slim progress bar and a custom-drawn table.

BuildMonitor(parent=None)

def finish(self, exit_code: int, stopped: bool = False): 
925    def finish(self, exit_code: int, stopped: bool = False):
926        if not self._active:
927            return
928        self._active = False
929        self._finished_at = time.monotonic()
930        for t in self.targets:
931            if t.status == COMPILING:
932                # A sibling's failure (or Stop) kills files still compiling.
933                t.finished = self._finished_at
934                self._set_status(t, ABORTED if (stopped or exit_code != 0) else DONE)
935        if stopped:
936            self._result = "stopped"
937        elif exit_code != 0:
938            self._result = "failed"
939        elif self._result != "uptodate" or self.targets:
940            self._result = "ok"
941            self._percent = 100
942        self.progress.set(self._percent / 100, {"uptodate": "ok"}.get(self._result, self._result))
943        self.update_header()
944        self.table.viewport().update()
def feed_line(self, line: str): 
947    def feed_line(self, line: str):
948        """Process one complete line of fpm output."""
949        if not self._active:
950            return
951        line = line.rstrip()
952        if not line:
953            return
954
955        match = PROGRESS_RE.match(line)
956        if match:
957            percent, name, end = int(match.group(1)), match.group(2).strip(), match.group(3)
958            self._percent = max(self._percent, percent)
959            self.progress.set(self._percent / 100)
960            if end:
961                target = self._find(name, running=True) or self._add(name)
962                if target.status == COMPILING:
963                    target.finished = time.monotonic()
964                    self._read_log(target)
965                    self._set_status(target, FAILED if end == "failed" or target.errors
966                                     else WARNING if target.warnings else DONE)
967            else:
968                self._add(name)
969            self._header_later()
970            return
971
972        match = FAILED_OBJECT_RE.search(line)
973        if match:
974            target = self._find_object(match.group(1))
975            if target:
976                self._mark_failed(target)
977            self._header_later()
978            return
979
980        if UP_TO_DATE_RE.search(line):
981            self._percent = 100
982            self._result = "uptodate"
983            self.progress.set(1.0, "ok")
984            self.update_header()
985            return
986
987        self._parse_diagnostic(line)

Process one complete line of fpm output.

1217        elif self._result == "stopped":

1219        elif self._active:

1221        else:

1223        self.progress_label.setText(text)
